# Workspace guidance

- This is SchemeSathi, a React + TypeScript + Vite prototype for discovering Indian government schemes.
- Keep scheme criteria and benefits source-cited; don't imply eligibility when rules are missing or unverified. Clearly direct users to official portals.
- Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `npm run lint` after code changes.
- Keep the interface responsive, keyboard-accessible, and privacy-conscious; do not send profile data to external services.
